item: a bigger SQLite page cache on the connections a bulk re-index writes through
summary: reindex_articles now runs inside bulk_page_cache: connections the calling thread checks out for the run get cache_size min(1024 MiB, RAM/16) (nothing below 4 GiB RAM or when RAM is unmeasured; OO_REINDEX_CACHE_MB overrides, 0 = off) and go back to their old size on checkin; other threads' checkouts untouched; it only ever grows a cache. Measured on a SQLCipher 100k-article store, 1,000 articles with changed rows, serial: mention write 40.4 s -> 12.8 s (3.2x) but commits 11 s -> 21 s, wall 99.4 s -> 78.3 s by env and 75.6 s with the shipped default (1.3x). Limits: warm OS cache, 2.9 GB not 41 GB, one run each, synthetic rows; no gain when rows are unchanged. 215 re-index tests pass.
